player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Tower of Hanoi with {num_disks} disks.
You have to move the disks from tower A to tower C.
To move a disk, type the source tower and the target tower (e.g., '[A C]').
Note that you can only move the top disk of a tower, and that a bigger disk cannot be placed on a smaller disk.
At each turn, submit one move.

invalid_move.wrong_format: I ka ca a yɛlɛma '[source] [target]' fɛ.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: I ye sɛbɛri kɛ k'a yira ko i ka jaa wala a yɔrɔ tɛ se ka baara kɛ.
invalid_move.empty_tower: I y'a ɲini ka disikiw sama k'u bila yɔrɔ wɛrɛ.
invalid_move.same_tower: I tun b'a fɛ ka disiki dɔ bila o sangaso kelen kɔnɔ.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: I y'a ɲini ka disiki belebeleba don minan fitinin dɔ kɔnɔ.

game_action.moved: I don ni {disk} kɔnɔ ye {source} ma {target}.

outcome.win: Congratulations! You solved the Tower of Hanoi puzzle.
outcome.turn_limit: I ye disiki {pct}% kɛ ka ɲɛsin C sankaso ma.
